hazards.message:
compute_directional_rates: headings look like degrees (largest magnitude 180, all within ±360, and consecutive values differ by up to 359.9, more than the π a continuous radian angle can step) but are read as radians, which wraps them into meaningless directions. Convert with np.radians(headings) or pass angle_unit="deg".
